references.text: Parallel account in Joshua describing how Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth-Shean, Taanach, Dor, Ibleam and Megiddo with their villages.
Describes the Canaanites' iron chariots that made it difficult for Manasseh to drive them out from the valleys.
Same theme about how the Israelites were unable to drive out the inhabitants of the valleys because of iron chariots.
Continues the theme by explaining that when Israel became stronger, they imposed forced labor on the Canaanites but did not completely drive them out.
Megiddo is mentioned as one of the cities in Solomon's fifth district, showing that these areas later came under Israeli control.
Megiddo is mentioned together with other cities that Solomon built up using forced labor.
God's command for the Israelites to drive out and strike the Canaanites with the ban, which Manasseh did not fully follow.
